label: Fugue in E minor, BWV 548
note: the “Wedge”; from the Prelude and Fugue
caution: Read from Tobi's MusicXML file (Tobis Notenarchiv), notes, ties and names as they stand there; the voices were sorted by this program from the file's staves, stems and beams, and have not been proofread note by note. The pedal's line is the bass. The middle of the fugue is free, concerto-like passage work, and the opening section comes back whole at the end.
title: Prelude and Fugue in E minor ("Wedge"), BWV 548: Fugue

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from countersubject 1. Alto: a figure from the subject (3 times) and a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and the opening of the subject, inverted, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Tenor: a figure from countersubject 1 (2 times) and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every bar. Returns in Episode 13 (bars 193–205).
